modules: Facts module changes evidence/interpretation rule plus two factual examples. Style module changes current-request/closure rule plus two closure/new-question examples. Factorial module ablation, not separate causal attribution to rule vs example. Other rules identical.

rules.facts: Use given facts in drafts and roleplay. Unknown testimony stays unknown; no hint of a private source or withheld evidence. State your own objection. Invent no past quotes, acts, reactions or promises. Possible effects are not results. Keep incidents local; no hidden-motive choices. Drop corrected readings. Fiction may add details. Respond in your current role. Give requested wording or advice. After agreement, close without recapping duties, teaching its value or seeking feedback. Explain only live confusion or risk.
rules.style: Use supplied facts in drafts and roleplay. Never invent a private disclosure, quote, action or reaction to win agreement. Requested fiction may add details, but not contradict given facts. Speak for yourself; laughter does not prove feelings. Leave unknown motives open, even in questions; one incident is not a lasting pattern. Drop corrected readings. Answer the current request in role. Write requested work; give advice or scripts when asked. Once terms are accepted, close without teaching merits, restating duties or seeking feedback. New questions need only new answers.
rules.combined: Use given facts in drafts and roleplay. Unknown testimony stays unknown; no hint of a private source or withheld evidence. State your own objection. Invent no past quotes, acts, reactions or promises. Possible effects are not results. Keep incidents local; no hidden-motive choices. Drop corrected readings. Fiction may add details. Answer the current request in role. Write requested work; give advice or scripts when asked. Once terms are accepted, close without teaching merits, restating duties or seeking feedback. New questions need only new answers.

selection: All three variants vs common round3 control on10 development scripts, both orders. Eligible if major required-content either-order replies and overinterpretation both-order replies do not exceed control. Rank lexicographically: major content either-order replies; all content both-order replies; overinterpretation both-order replies; motive+relationship tone means; coaching mean; repeated-closing both-order replies; unnecessary-question both-order replies; negative naturalness net stable wins; negative overall net stable wins. Tie prefer facts, style, combined. If none eligible, retain control. Immutable one-time choice, no score/disagreement retries. Independently validate selected+control on8 scripts before full150 Follow+same12 EQ. Validation cannot switch candidate; failures reported without retuning.
judge: Same anchored scale and six violations plus explicitly registered evidence clarification about misleading private-source implications. Rejudge both conditions identically; do not splice prior-round counts. Include only the actual candidate-visible date/time envelopes from retained trace receipts, one per assistant reply; no persona internal states.
gates: All150 valid Follow and12 EQ, unchanged source; Follow HSR>=round3 113/150; EQ coaching decrease>=0.25, motive and relationship means nonincrease, overinterpretation/nonessential-question/repeated-closing both-order affected conversations nonincrease; no new major content/boundary/blocking in EQ or validation, overall/naturalness stable wins>=losses; independent validation content/overinterpretation/repeated-closing both-order conversations nonincrease. S06 and S11 creative delivery/style guards separately reviewed.
recovery: Only one separately retained same-input supplemental judge call per service/protocol failure; never regenerate a scored answer or rerun disagreement. One retained same-source fresh-scene restart per candidate transport failure; disclose changed trajectory.
limitations: Residual-derived scripts not unseen population data. Single samples and same model judge; EQ trajectories/exposure differ, pointwise sees hidden persona/internal text whereas blind sees visible/public context. No significance claim.
protocolAmendment: v1 blind omitted candidate-visible timestamp envelopes and misclassified the correct October23 Friday as invented. Preserve all v1 artifacts and selection; no candidate/fixture changes. Rejudge ALL development conditions under v2 using actual inbound timestamp frames, mapped with display side; choose once on corrected development, then independent validation, then full. Reuse valid captures, never regenerate a valid answer for its score. No pooling between batches.
